title: A Visitor for the Portrait
author: Wren Vasquez
blurb: Quentin Oyelaran, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
